title: Astrid and the Letter
author: Ulyana Pemberton
blurb: Jonah Vasquez, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ice breaks on the river.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
